mapper.select: SELECT A.OBJECT_ID,A.SECID,A.OPTIONNUM, date_format(A.OPTIONSTARTDAY,'%Y-%m-%d') OPTIONSTARTDAY, date_format(A.OPTIONENDDAY,'%Y-%m-%d') OPTIONENDDAY, date_format(A.OPTIONPAYDAY,'%Y-%m-%d') OPTIONPAYDAY, A.OPTIONPRICE, CASE A.OPTIONTYPE WHEN 'CALL' THEN '01' WHEN 'PUT' THEN '02'END OPTIONTYPE, date_format(A.LSTMNTDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') LSTMNTDATE, A.LSTMNTUSER, A.EFFECTFLAG, date_format(A.OPDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') OPDATE,A.OPMODE FROM ( SELECT OBJECT_ID, concat_ws('',SUBSTR(SECID,3), '.', SUBSTR(SECID,1,2)) SECID, OPTIONNUM, OPTIONSTARTDAY,OPTIONENDDAY, OPTIONPAYDAY, OPTIONPRICE,UPPER(OPTIONTYPE) OPTIONTYPE,LSTMNTDATE, LSTMNTUSER, CASE EFFECTFLAG WHEN 'E' THEN '01' WHEN 'D' THEN '03' END EFFECTFLAG, OPDATE,OPMODE FROM PAYHSRCSECOPTION ) A WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT T WHERE T.FINPROD_TYPE='F01' AND A.SECID = T.FINPROD_ID ) AND date_format(A.OPDATE,'%Y%m%d')= #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
